  c.name AS circuit_name,
  c.location,
  c.country,
  lt.driverId,
  d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
  r.year,
  r.name AS race_name,
  lt.lap,
  lt.time AS lap_time,
  lt.milliseconds
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN lapTimes lt ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND lt.milliseconds = (
    SELECT MIN(lt2.milliseconds)
    FROM races r2
    JOIN lapTimes lt2 ON lt2.raceId = r2.raceId
    WHERE r2.circuitId = c.circuitId
      AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY c.circuitId, lt.milliseconds ASC
